name: vork (headless 3D/VFX engine for agents)
summary: Voyager's Rust + Slang rendering kernel: a headless 3D and VFX engine where coding agents write scenes, shaders, materials, cameras, simulation and compositing as code, render a preview, inspect it and iterate. Hardware ray tracing on Vulkan/Metal; examples include a million-bird murmuration, VFX on real footage and a black hole. Source-available, free during the research preview.

access.price: $0 during research preview; later versions may be paid
access.notes: Not open source: no resale, no distributing modified versions, no hosted render service. Your renders are yours. Blender bridge is GPL-3.0+. Needs NVIDIA RT GPU (Linux/Windows) or Apple Silicon macOS 26.

procedure: Download vork-0.1.0 for your OS from GitHub Releases (or run install.sh / install.ps1)
Keep the whole install folder together
Tell your agent: read `vork help`, make a small scene, render a preview and inspect it

verdict.why: Strong traction (~4K likes on launch post, 539 stars in a day), release binaries answer 200, license read: free incl. commercial use for this version. Docked for source-available terms and research-preview status.
